projects.title: DirectEdge
projects.shortDesc: Cutting out the middlemen — a smart supply chain that connects farmers, distributors, and shop owners directly.
projects.fullDesc: DirectEdge reimagines the agricultural supply chain by eliminating inefficiencies caused by middlemen. It's a three-sided platform where farmers manage crop listings in real time, distributors handle warehouse logistics, and shop owners gain AI-powered inventory management with demand forecasting. Computer vision powers automatic receipt generation, while ML models predict stock needs before shortages occur.
features: Real-time crop listing and inventory management for farmers
AI-powered demand forecasting using ML (scikit-learn / XGBoost)
Computer vision-based receipt generation for shops
Multi-role dashboards: Farmer, Distributor, Shop Owner, Admin
Delivery scheduling and warehouse management module
Personalized coupons, ratings, and email confirmations
Analytics and reporting dashboard for all roles

projects.title: Kairos
projects.shortDesc: Your personal growth OS — goals, habits, journaling, and accountability all woven into one digital ecosystem.
projects.fullDesc: Kairos (Greek for 'the right moment') is a life management web application built as a digital companion for intentional living. Rather than a simple to-do app, it weaves together goal tracking, daily journaling, habit monitoring, blogging, and community features into one unified ecosystem. The platform is designed around the idea that lasting growth needs structure, reflection, and accountability together.

award.title: UIU CSE Project Show — Spring 2024
award.subtitle: Database Management Systems Category · 71 competing teams

features: Goal tracking with deadlines, milestones, and completion status
Anti-procrastination module with structured accountability
Private journal for daily reflection and emotional tracking
Good/bad event logging for behavioral pattern awareness
Community blog with post creation and social interaction
Self-learning portal with curated resources
Admin moderation dashboard for platform management
Session-based authentication with protected routes

projects.title: Cook Corner
projects.shortDesc: Turn what's in your fridge into what's on your plate — a smart culinary companion built for real kitchens.
projects.fullDesc: Cook Corner solves the daily dilemma of 'what should I cook?' by combining recipe discovery, nutrition-aware meal planning, ingredient-based recipe generation, and grocery assistance into one platform. Built for home cooks, health-conscious users, and food lovers who want to cook smarter, waste less, and eat better.
features: Ingredient-based recipe generation (cook with what you have)
Nutrition-aware meal planning with calorie and macro tracking
Recipe discovery by cuisine, occasion, and dietary preference
Grocery list generation and shopping assistance
Cooking courses and kitchen tips educational section
Personalized recipe recommendations engine
Meal history and nutritional progress tracking

projects.title: UIU Health Care Management
projects.shortDesc: Digitizing university healthcare — from booking an appointment to chatting with your doctor in real time.
projects.fullDesc: Built for United International University, this platform centralizes all campus medical services into one role-based system. Patients book appointments and track medical history; doctors manage schedules and patient data; admins monitor the full healthcare ecosystem with real-time dashboards. A dedicated Socket.IO chat module enables direct doctor-patient communication without leaving the platform.
features: Role-based system: Admin, Doctor, and Patient dashboards
Appointment booking, scheduling, and history tracking
Multiple payment methods: Cash, Card, Mobile Banking
Real-time one-to-one chat (Node.js + Express + Socket.IO)
Doctor schedule management and patient data module
Emergency alerts and admin monitoring dashboard
Complete patient profile and medical history management
FAQ and support section for patients

projects.title: codeCAMPUSTrail
projects.shortDesc: One campus, one platform — where students compete, ask questions, and learn alongside their teachers.
projects.fullDesc: codeCAMPUSTrail is a JavaFX desktop application that creates a unified digital campus experience. It's a social and educational hybrid where students and teachers interact through a news feed, share announcements, run coding contests, post queries, access learning resources, and chat in real time. The app features smooth AnimateFX animations and an auto-typing welcome screen that makes it feel alive.
features: Role-based access: separate Student and Teacher dashboards
News feed with post creation and community interaction
Coding contests with leaderboard and ranking system
Announcement system managed by teachers
Query feed for student questions and peer answers
Learning portal with curated educational resources
Real-time chat room (custom client-server in Java)
Smooth UI animations via AnimateFX library
Embedded web browser integration within the app
Auto-typing animation on the welcome screen
